answer: To curb Sybil attacks, an agent economy can anchor identities to multipath telemetry inside an urban canyon. A node authenticates by timing pulsed emissions from an optical lantern against the phase ripple of ambient radio echoes. An attacker must place discrete physical sensors inside the canyon for each identity, imposing heavy hardware and spatial deployment costs. However, transient vehicular traffic alters the local reflection geometry, occasionally causing false rejections.
